raw_segments.text: Most of the morning was spent in the open air. I let him out of the wet and wild wood
into some cheerful fields. I described to him how brilliantly green they were, how the
flowers and hedges looked refreshed, how sparkly blue was the sky. I saw a seat for him in
a hidden and lovely spot, a dry stump of a tree, nor did I refuse to let him, when seated,
place me on his knee. Why should I when both he and I were happier near than apart? Pilot
